title: 第25章 孟珏求救场周武初显实力第26章 绝色萝莉罗烟步
content_zh:
“310万。”
“320万。”
“350万。”
“……”
叫价涨得非常快，很快价格就涨到了四百万。
何诗韵咬了咬牙，举牌：“430万。”
“500万。”
兰玥瑜举起牌子，冷笑地看何诗韵一眼。
何诗韵继续举牌：“510万。”
“600万。”
没有丝毫犹豫，兰玥瑜再次加价。
何诗韵目光望向张扬，哪知后者就像没看到她的暗示一样。
最终，养生图以600万被兰玥瑜拍下。
何诗韵很无奈，但是没有办法，五百万已经是她的极限。
下一件竞品是一个翡翠冰种手镯，比玻璃还通透，起拍价一千万。
张扬举牌：“1100万。”
兰玥瑜举牌：“1200万。”
张扬：“1500万。”
兰玥瑜看出张扬志在必得，心想恶心一下，又加了一百万。
结果张扬不再加价了，她方知自己上当了。

接下来，张扬每看中一件东西，兰玥瑜都叫价。
兰玥瑜每看上一件东西，张扬也故意把价抬高，两人杠上了。
不知道为什么，每次兰玥瑜想放弃的时候，张扬就先放弃。
几轮下来，兰玥瑜溢价拍了四五件东西，张扬愣是一件都没拍到。
终于，到了那株百年老山参。
“起拍价200万，每次加价不少于5万，竞价开始。”
女主持话音刚落，周围竞价声密集响起，价格很快就涨到了400万。
翻一倍价格之后，叫价声分明少了下来。
张扬举牌：“450万。”
喊完价之后，还故意挑衅地看了远处的兰玥瑜一眼。
兰玥瑜没再跟，以为张扬又在抬价，引她入坑。
百年灵药虽然珍贵，但毕竟是消耗品，服用完就没了，虽说对武者有用但是效果不是特别大。
content_en:
"3.1 million."
"3.2 million."
"3.5 million."
"..."
The asking price went up very quickly, and soon the price reached four million.
He Shiyun gritted her teeth and held up her sign: "4.3 million."
"Five million."
Lan Yueyu raised the sign and looked at He Shiyun with a sneer.
He Shiyun continued to hold up the sign: "5.1 million."
"Six million."
Without any hesitation, Lan Yueyu increased the price again.
He Shiyun looked at Zhang Yang, but the latter seemed not to see her hint.
In the end, the health picture was photographed by Lan Yueyu for 6 million.
He Shiyun was helpless, but there was no way. Five million was already her limit.
The next competing item is an emerald ice bracelet, which is more transparent than glass, with a starting price of 10 million.
Zhang Yang held up a sign: "11 million."
Lan Yueyu held up a sign: "12 million."
Zhang Yang: "15 million."
Lan Yueyu saw that Zhang Yang was determined to win, so she felt disgusted and added another million.
As a result, Zhang Yang stopped raising the price, and she realized that she had been cheated.
Next, every time Zhang Yang took a fancy to something, Lan Yueyu bid for it.
Every time Lan Yueyu fell in love with something, Zhang Yang also deliberately raised the price, and the two of them came to terms with each other.
I don't know why, but every time Lan Yueyu wants to give up, Zhang Yang gives up first.
After several rounds, Lan Yueyu took pictures of four or five things at a premium, but Zhang Yang was stunned not to take pictures of any of them.
Finally, we arrived at the century-old wild ginseng.
"The starting price is 2 million, and each increase will be no less than 50,000. The bidding begins."
As soon as the hostess finished speaking, there were intense bidding sounds all around, and the price quickly rose to 4 million.
After doubling the price, the number of bidding calls decreased significantly.
Zhang Yang held up a sign: "4.5 million."
After calling out the price, he glanced at Lan Yueyu in the distance deliberately and provocatively.
Lan Yueyu stopped following, thinking that Zhang Yang was raising the price again to lure her into a trap.
Although the hundred-year elixir is precious, it is a consumable after all. It is gone after taking it. Although it is useful for warriors, the effect is not particularly great.
